extracted_concepts.name: Sample Space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Set Ω of all possible outcomes of a random experiment E

extracted_concepts.name: Event
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A subset of the sample space Ω

extracted_concepts.name: Axioms of Probability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: P(A)≥0, P(Ω)=1, countable additivity for disjoint events

extracted_concepts.name: Classical Probability Model
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: P(A)=|A|/|Ω| when all outcomes are equally likely

extracted_concepts.name: Conditional Probability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: P(B|A)=P(AB)/P(A)

extracted_concepts.name: Bayes' Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: P(Aⱼ|B)=P(Aⱼ)P(B|Aⱼ)/ΣP(Aᵢ)P(B|Aᵢ)

extracted_concepts.name: Independence of Events
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A and B independent iff P(AB)=P(A)P(B)

extracted_concepts.name: Random Variable
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Function X: Ω → ℝ assigning a real number to each outcome

extracted_concepts.name: Probability Mass Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: P(X=xₖ)=pₖ for discrete random variables

extracted_concepts.name: Binomial Distribution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: B(n,p): number of successes in n independent trials

extracted_concepts.name: Poisson Distribution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: P(λ): distribution for counts of rare events

extracted_concepts.name: Probability Density Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f(x)≥0 with ∫f(x)dx=1 for continuous random variables

extracted_concepts.name: Cumulative Distribution Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: F(x)=P(X≤x)=∫₋∞ˣ f(t)dt

extracted_concepts.name: Normal Distribution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: N(μ,σ²): bell-shaped continuous distribution

extracted_concepts.name: Joint Distribution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: F(x,y)=P(X≤x,Y≤y) with joint PDF f(x,y), ∫∫f(x,y)dxdy=1

extracted_concepts.name: Marginal Distribution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f_X(x)=∫f(x,y)dy obtained from the joint density

extracted_concepts.name: Independence of Random Variables
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: X⊥Y ⟺ f(x,y)=f_X(x)f_Y(y)

extracted_concepts.name: Convolution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f_Z(z)=∫f(x,z-x)dx for the sum Z=X+Y

extracted_concepts.name: Expectation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: E(X)=∫xf(x)dx or Σxₖpₖ; linear: E(aX+b)=aE(X)+b

extracted_concepts.name: Variance
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Var(X)=E[(X-μ)²]=E(X²)-[E(X)]²

extracted_concepts.name: Covariance
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Cov(X,Y)=E(XY)-E(X)E(Y)

extracted_concepts.name: Correlation Coefficient
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ρ=Cov(X,Y)/√(Var(X)Var(Y)) with |ρ|≤1

extracted_concepts.name: Chebyshev's Inequality
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: P(|X̄-μ|≥ε)≤σ²/(nε²)

extracted_concepts.name: Law of Large Numbers
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: X̄ → μ almost surely as n grows

extracted_concepts.name: Sample Mean
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: X̄ with X̄ ~ N(μ,σ²/n) for normal populations

extracted_concepts.name: Sample Variance
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: S² with (n-1)S²/σ² ~ χ²(n-1)

extracted_concepts.name: Chi-Square Distribution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: χ²(n-1): sampling distribution of scaled sample variance

extracted_concepts.name: t-Distribution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: t distribution for inference on normal means with unknown σ

extracted_concepts.name: F-Distribution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: F distribution used for comparing two variances

extracted_concepts.name: Method of Moments
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equate sample and population moments to estimate parameters

extracted_concepts.name: Maximum Likelihood Estimation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Maximize L(θ)=Πf(xᵢ;θ)

extracted_concepts.name: Unbiasedness
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Estimator property E(θ̂)=θ

extracted_concepts.name: Consistency
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Estimator property θ̂ →^P θ as n→∞

extracted_concepts.name: Confidence Interval
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: X̄ ± z_{α/2}σ/√n (σ known) or X̄ ± t_{α/2}(n-1)S/√n (σ unknown)

extracted_concepts.name: Hypothesis Testing
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: H₀ vs H₁ framework with test statistic, rejection region, significance level α

extracted_concepts.name: Z-test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Z=(X̄-μ₀)/(σ/√n) for normal mean when σ known

extracted_concepts.name: t-test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: T=(X̄-μ₀)/(S/√n) for normal mean when σ unknown

extracted_concepts.name: Chi-Square Test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: χ²=(n-1)S²/σ₀² test for normal variance

extracted_concepts.name: F-test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: F=S₁²/S₂² test for equality of two variances

extracted_relations.evidence: X: Ω → ℝ is defined on the sample space
PMF P(X=xₖ)=pₖ represents a discrete distribution
PDF f(x) represents a continuous distribution
B(n,p) is represented by its PMF
N(μ,σ²) is represented by its PDF
Extends event independence P(AB)=P(A)P(B) to random variables
f_Z(z)=∫f(x,z-x)dx uses the joint density for Z=X+Y
De Moivre-Laplace (Binomial≈Normal) is a special case
θ̂ →^P θ relies on convergence in probability
Z=(X̄-μ₀)/(σ/√n) uses standard normal critical values
